name: Cerium dioxide (fluorite)
notes: The ambient fluorite cell is the value measured in the EoS study. Peak intensities are calculated Cu K-alpha powder intensities for the ideal structure.

eos_records.label: Gerward et al. (2005), room-temperature BM3
eos_records.reference: Gerward et al., J. Alloys Compd. 400, 56-61 (2005), doi:10.1016/j.jallcom.2005.04.008
eos_records.notes: Room-temperature powder XRD fit of the cubic fluorite phase. The equation fits K0 and K0_prime using measured a0=5.411(1) A; V0=a0^3 and its error is propagated as 3*a0^2*sigma_a.
